Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and wood, metal, and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Wood, Metal, and Plastic. Colour: Green. Stated size: 150 cm. Product weight: 3.4 kg. Quantity: 1 piece.
Compact artificial Christmas tree with a defined green finish, ideal for creating a festive focal point in any home setting.
Constructed from durable wood, metal, and plastic materials to ensure longevity and maintain its shape season after season.
Versatile decorative accessory that adds a touch of holiday cheer and can be easily repositioned to suit different display arrangements.
Stands at a convenient 150 cm height, providing a substantial presence without overwhelming smaller spaces or shelves.
Guarantee - 1 month
Artificial christmas tree type: Hinged
Assembly required
With stand

Coordinate colour and texture

Style around the occasion

Give the detail room to show

5052532134642.sourceDescription:
Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Shatter Resistant Design
The ornaments use a shatter resistant construction for the stated decorative use. They provide an alternative to traditional glass decorations when arranging the display, while retaining a defined shape and finish for the festive setting.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Burgundy and Gold. Quantity: 1 piece.
Shatter resistant plastic construction ensures safe festive decoration without breakage risks.
Lightweight design allows easy handling and convenient storage in bags or spaces.
Burgundy and gold colour scheme adds a classic, coordinated focal point to your tree.
Single piece ornament provides versatile styling for branches or seasonal displays.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Resistant to shattering
Included: 1 piece of Christmas Baubles
Hanger included

5056797097742.variantName: MySmartBuy Twinkling Micro LED Christmas Wreath Light, Warm White, Timer
5056797097742.sourceDescription:
Give your home a twinkling festive welcome with this pre-lit 2D wreath from MySmartBuy. Warm white micro LEDs on a sleek black wire frame are finished with a 10% twinkle effect, so the wreath shimmers softly all evening. Choose from 38cm with 480 LEDs, 50cm with 720 LEDs or 58cm with 960 LEDs. It arrives fully assembled with a hanging point, so it is ready to go straight onto a door, wall or window, and the sturdy storage box keeps it safe between seasons. Suitable for indoor and outdoor use. It is supplied with a 5m lead cable, giving plenty of reach from your socket, and the built-in timer takes care of switching it on and off, for effortless seasonal lighting. A lit wreath is the perfect finishing touch for the front of the house, giving visitors a warm welcome and making your home look instantly festive from the street. Pair it with matching lights along the porch or a garland around the door frame for a coordinated look. A beautiful way to welcome guests this Christmas, it can be brought out year after year to make your home look instantly festive. At a glance: 2D wreath with 10% twinkle | warm white micro LEDs | black wire frame | 38cm (480 LEDs), 50cm (720 LEDs) or 58cm (960 LEDs) | fully assembled with hanging point | storage box | 5m lead | timer | indoor and outdoor use.
TWINKLING 2D WREATH : Warm white micro LEDs with a 10% twinkle effect on a sleek black wire frame.
THREE SIZES : 38cm with 480 LEDs, 50cm with 720 LEDs or 58cm with 960 LEDs.
FULLY ASSEMBLED : Arrives ready to hang with a hanging point, plus a sturdy storage box for easy packing away.
5M LEAD CABLE : Supplied with a 5m lead cable, giving plenty of reach from your socket to your chosen spot.
INDOOR AND OUTDOOR USE : Lovely on front doors, walls and windows.

Product Overview

 This hanging wall Christmas tree decoration comes in 3 different styles. 
 It adopts a space-saving wall-mounted design instead of a bulky freestanding Christmas tree. 
 Equipped with warm white fairy lights and assorted festive ornaments, it creates a cozy holiday atmosphere.
 Lightweight and easy to hang, perfect for limited-space homes, apartments and small rooms.

Material & Dimensions

 Size: 113cm (3.7ft) height, 55cm (1.8ft) width
 Style : Artificial pine needle branches, decorated with star topper, red bow, baubles, pine cones, Santa pendants and cinnamon sticks
 Material: PE pine / natural wood / fabric ribbon, plastic baubles, wooden hanging ornaments, copper wire fairy lights
 Power: Battery operated (batteries not included)

Application Scenarios
Ideal for indoor wall, door, window, fireplace, entryway decor. Great for Christmas party decoration, apartment, dorm, small house where traditional Christmas tree takes too much floor space. Also works as a unique holiday gift for family and friends.
Notes

 Battery powered, please prepare batteries by yourself.
 It is a wall hanging decoration, not a freestanding tree. Hang it on hooks, nails or door hangers.
 Keep away from open flame and moisture.
 Handle ornaments gently to avoid dropping during installation.
【Unique Rustic Ladder Design, Maximal Charm, Zero Floor Space】- Celebrate the holidays without sacrificing precious floor space! Our charming 6-tier wooden ladder Christmas tree hangs elegantly on any wall or door. Measuring 3.7ft tall and 1.8ft wide at the base, it delivers all the festive spirit of a traditional tree in a unique, rustic package that’s perfect for apartments, small homes, or adding a festive accent to any room.
【Complete & Ready for Instant Holiday Cheer】- This wall Christmas tree arrives ready to bring joy! It comes with LED lights and is beautifully adorned with classic Christmas ball ornaments, festive bows, and topped with a shining star tree topper. Simply hang it up—no tedious decorating.
【Handcrafted from Natural Wood for a Cozy Farmhouse Feel】- Each tier is crafted from natural birch or pine-look wood, bringing authentic warmth and rustic texture to your holiday decor. Combined with accents of plastic berries and satin ribbon, this piece is a tasteful blend of natural and festive elements, ideal for farmhouse, cabin, or modern rustic interiors.
【Easy to Install & Versatile Holiday Display】- Includes a convenient hanging cord for quick and secure installation on any wall hook or nail. Its lightweight yet sturdy construction makes it perfect for your living room accent wall, a welcoming statement on your front door, a festive touch on your porch, or even as a charming backdrop in your office or bedroom.
【Reusable Centerpiece & Thoughtful Gift Idea】- Designed for durability, this hanging tree is a decoration you'll cherish for many seasons. It also makes an incredibly thoughtful and unique gift for new homeowners, apartment dwellers, or anyone who loves stylish, space-smart Christmas decor.

5058194836542.sourceDescription:
Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and linen construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Linen. Colour: Green. Stated size: 11 cm. Quantity: 5 pack.
Pack of five lightweight linen Christmas wreaths for festive home decoration.
Durable reusable design allows for easy storage and repeated seasonal use.
Classic green linen finish adds a traditional touch to any door or wall display.
Compact 11 cm size is perfect for creating charming focal points in small spaces.
Comes with 5 x Christmas Wreaths

Christmas Garland
This Christmas garland adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The white finish and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: White. Stated size: 50 cm. Quantity: 6 piece set.
Lightweight plastic construction for easy handling and storage.
Festive white finish adds a defined decorative detail to displays.
6-piece set provides ample coverage for coordinated Christmas styling.
Compact 50 cm length allows flexible placement in various settings.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Included: 6x Christmas garlands

* Props, fixings, and batteries are not included.

5059442168842.sourceDescription:
The original Christmas tree, the Norway Spruce has been grown in the UK since Victorian times and is the variety most people picture at Christmas. Its classic conical shape, dark green foliage and fresh scent bring a traditional, nostalgic feel to your home, and its firm, slightly prickly needles are ideal for hanging decorations. Norway Spruce can drop needles if it dries out, so keeping it well watered is key. Our trees are grown in the UK and freshly cut before dispatch. When your tree arrives, cut a few centimetres from the base of the trunk and stand it in water straight away. Keep it in a stand with a water reservoir, topped up every 1-2 days, and away from radiators and fires so it stays fresh throughout Christmas.

TRADITIONAL LOOK AND FEEL - The classic Christmas tree look, with dark green foliage and firm, slightly prickly needles that are ideal for hanging decorations
STAND SOLD SEPARATELY - A stand with a water reservoir is vital for keeping your tree fresh. Pop your tree in, fill it with water and you're ready to decorate
